classification.conformanceProfile: W3C SVG bounded static primitive display/exchange profile

formatPolicy.renderEquivalenceBoundary: Raster byte/pixel equality across conforming renderers is not required by R1; decodeability, dimensions and non-empty output are independently observed.

xmlWellFormedness.claim: libxml2 xmllint parses the exact SVG bytes as well-formed XML with network access disabled

boundedStaticProfile.claim: the SVG namespace, root geometry, element set, attributes and references remain inside the bounded static-safe R1 subset

referenceRender.claim: librsvg renders the exact SVG bytes to a non-empty RGBA PNG at the observed intrinsic raster dimensions

browserTargetMatrix.claim: pinned Chromium and Firefox decode the exact SVG bytes as images with matching intrinsic dimensions and non-empty rasterized alpha

rendererDivergenceObservation.claim: browser raster checksums and non-transparent-pixel counts are recorded so implementation differences are visible rather than silently normalized

nonClaims: complete SVG 1.1 or SVG 2 language conformance
dynamic SVG, scripting, animation, CSS cascade or external-resource behavior
accessibility quality or text alternative suitability
semantic or artistic correctness of the image
print color fidelity or physical-size accuracy
